entries.speaker: Manager
entries.en: Oh, you're the new part-timer, right?[n]I've been expecting you.

entries.speaker: Manager
entries.en: No need to introduce yourself. I actually[n]need you to start working right away.

entries.speaker: Manager
entries.en: Do you have any questions about[n]the job?

entries.speaker: Manager
entries.en: Take customers' orders, prep them,[n]serve them, ring them up, and then[n]clean the store.
entries.uk: Приймаєш замовлення, готуєш, подаєш,[n]розраховуєш клієнтів, а потім[n]прибираєш у закладі.

entries.speaker: Manager
entries.en: The meals are all ready-made, so[n]it should be simple. Just make sure[n]you're nice to the customers, okay?
entries.uk: Страви всі готові, тож має бути[n]просто. Головне — будь привітним[n]із клієнтами, гаразд?

entries.speaker: Manager
entries.en: Not quite. Our budget's been cut[n]despite being short-staffed... so[n]you'll have to do everything alone.
entries.uk: Не зовсім. Людей бракує, а бюджет[n]нам ще й урізали... тож усе[n]доведеться робити самому.

entries.speaker: Manager
entries.en: You're a spry young dude, right?[n]You'll be fine. I'll pay you more[n]to make up for the extra work!
entries.uk: Ти ж молодий і жвавий, так?[n]Упораєшся. За зайву роботу[n]я доплачу!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This job is ludicrous. You have to do[n]everything all by yourself from the[n]very beginning?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh well. Just give it your best shot,[n]I guess. I'll be cheering you on.
entries.uk: Ну що ж. Просто постарайся як слід.[n]Я вболіватиму за тебе.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, there are dirty plates still left[n]on the table.
entries.uk: Агов, на столі досі стоять брудні[n]тарілки.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And there are customers in front[n]waiting to pay... Are you going to[n]be okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That customer in front of you is waiting[n]to pay. Ooh, that is one angry-looking[n]face...

entries.en: Hey, someone wants to change their[n]order. Add an egg? They should have[n]told us earlier.

entries.en: Hey, the meat's done. You'll burn it[n]if you let it cook any longer.
